text:
kevin (bench): quick triage — noticed p99 jumped ~1.8x after the new attention kernel switch on canary.

sara (runtime): I saw that too. It's narrow: only seen on 8k seq runs with small batch sizes.

mike (infra): can we reproduce locally with the harness? which dataset/seed?

kevin (bench): repro steps i used:

```
./smokebench --model rdlw-7b --seq-len 8192 --batch 2 --profile attention --seed 1234 --duration 600
```

sara (runtime): two hypotheses: 1) kernel selection fallback thrashes kernels because of jitter; 2) kv-cache warmup pattern interacts with batching.

jen (ml): also check output correctness - attention reorder could change tokenization timing. hash compare of outputs vs baseline?

kevin (bench): i compared sample responses, they match token-by-token for the short runs, but we haven't run long-run equivalence. I'll run golden-runs.

ci-bot: perf-bench triggered: https://ci.redwood/bench/1767554321

mike (infra): suggestion: add deterministic RNG for sampling and avoid mixed workloads in p99 calculation. propose two bench variants:
- steady-state (long warmup then measure)
- tail-injection (sporadic large seqs to exercise kernel switching)

sara (runtime): agree. also add explicit 'kernel-stay' flag to the harness so we can force one kernel and compare.

kevin (bench): actionable list:
1) run steady-state and tail-injection with seeds [42,1234,9999] (assigned to me)
2) add output-hash check post-run (assigned to jen)
3) add kernel-stay flag to harness (assigned to sara)
4) collect kernel transition logs + per-token latency histograms (assigned to mike)

jen (ml): for correctness, i'll run beam-sampled trace on 10 prompts and compute edit-distance + token-hash diffs.

mike (infra): i'll wire extra telemetry: record kernel_id on each step and emit compact histogram (p50/p90/p99/p999) per kernel.

kevin (bench): timeline: repro + initial runs by EOD today. if we confirm regression, revert-canary and start bisect.

sara (runtime): quick note: when you run, enable KV_WARMUP=1 env to ensure cache behavior is realistic.

kevin (bench): running now. I'll paste logs. thanks :thumbsup:

kevin (bench): (later)
logs show spikes when kernel switch happens around token ~2048 across runs. attaching snippet:

```
[2025-11-02T16:12:05Z] kernel_switch: from=matmul_fuse to=matmul_fp16 idx=2048 latency_ms=12.3
[2025-11-02T16:12:05Z] token_latency: p50=1.2 p90=3.1 p99=18.4
```

sara (runtime): that's consistent with cache refill + different kernel warmup. plan: implement prefetch path to prepare kernels before threshold.

mike (infra): also we should exclude cold-start tokens from p99 calculation, or at least report both cold-included and cold-excluded p99s for transparency.

kevin (bench): will add both metrics. if prefetch + kernel-stay reduce delta, we can keep change; else we revert.

jen (ml): noted. i'll start the token-diff batch.

ci-bot: action log updated: KEVIN assigned -> run-bench; SARA assigned -> kernel-flag; JEN assigned -> correctness-check; MIKE assigned -> telemetry

kevin (bench): closing loop once initial runs finish, will post a concise summary and attach histograms. thanks all.
